# Lease

`schemas/records/lease.json`

A unit's claim on an executor and its resource groups (docs/design/m0/05 "Lease"): the current state a lease's events project to. Reservations are made all-or-nothing inside the writer transaction; terminal states (settled, released) are immutable. internal/lease enforces the state machine.

## Fields of the document

| Field | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | yes | [LeaseID](common-defs.md#leaseid) |  |
| `unit` | yes | [UnitID](common-defs.md#unitid) |  |
| `role` | yes | [Name](records-receipt.md#name) |  |
| `executor` | yes | [ExecutorID](common-defs.md#executorid) |  |
| `state` | yes | one of `requested`, `waiting`, `granted`, `active`, `releasing`, `settling`, `restoring`, `restore_failed`, `settling_verified`, `settled`, `released` | requested, waiting, granted, active and releasing; settling, then (evidence targets) restoring, restore_failed and settling_verified; settled and released are terminal. |
| `reservations` | yes | array of object ([fields](#fields-of-reservations)) | One per resource group, all made or none. |
| `priority` | yes | integer (minimum `0`, maximum `1000`) |  |
| `footprint` | yes | object ([fields](#fields-of-footprint)) | Learned per executor from settled usage, starting from priors. |
| `deadline` | yes | [Time](common-defs.md#time) |  |
| `fallback_step` | yes | integer (minimum `0`, maximum `1000`) |  |
| `placement_checks` | yes | object ([fields](#fields-of-placement_checks)) | Re-evaluated and recorded at every fallback step. Each check is empty when nothing blocks; anything else blocks the grant. |
| `hold` | yes | null or object ([fields](#fields-of-hold)) | Set exactly while waiting or restore_failed: the registered hold (schemas/vocab/holds.yaml, checked by internal/lease; restore_failed holds evidence_restore_pending) and the concrete signal instance that resumes it (02). It is cleared when the lease leaves the state. |
| `attempt` | yes | null or [AttemptID](common-defs.md#attemptid) | The attempt this lease started, once active. |
| `restore_receipt` | yes | null or [ReceiptID](common-defs.md#receiptid) | An evidence-target lease's verified restore (13): set from settling_verified on, never before. Only a lease with one may publish a result at settlement; internal/lease checks that. |
| `settlement` | yes | null or object ([fields](#fields-of-settlement)) | Set at settled: the calls whose usage settled, those still an uncertain liability on their groups, and the result the controller published in the same transaction. Amounts live in the call ledger, never here. |

No other fields are allowed.

Conditional rules (5, `if`/`then`/`else` in the schema):

- when `state` one of `waiting`, `restore_failed`, then `hold` any (not `null`); otherwise `hold` `null`
- when `state` `settled`, then `settlement` any (not `null`); otherwise `settlement` `null`
- when `state` `settling_verified`, then `restore_receipt` any (not `null`)
- when `state` one of `requested`, `waiting`, `granted`, `releasing`, `released`, `active`, `settling`, `restoring`, `restore_failed`, then `restore_receipt` `null`
- when `state` one of `requested`, `waiting`, `granted`, `releasing`, `released`, then `attempt` `null`; otherwise `attempt` any (not `null`)

## Definitions

### PlacementCheck

Every result but empty names its detail (02). Whether the reason fits the outcome is the vocabulary's check, in internal/lease's placement validator.

#### Fields of PlacementCheck

| Field | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `outcome` | yes | [Outcome](common-defs.md#outcome) |  |
| `reason` | yes | [ReasonCode](common-defs.md#reasoncode) |  |
| `detail` | yes | string (maxLength `4096`) |  |

No other fields are allowed.

Conditional rules (1, `if`/`then`/`else` in the schema):

- when `outcome` one of `found`, `could_not_run`, `failed`, then `detail` any (not ``)
